accepted.quote: In conclusion, Committee Democrats could not support the Prove-It Act, which creates an unworkable bureaucratic process, and allows powerful companies to exploit rulemakings that benefit small businesses, and protect the health and safety of all Americans.
accepted.rationale: The passage explicitly states opposition to the Prove It Act on grounds it creates unworkable process and harms small businesses and health and safety protections.

new_issues.name: RFA Expansion and Small-Business Regulatory Review (Prove It Act)
